label: Longley Way ES (reference)
project_name: Longley Way Elementary School — Relocatable Classroom Buildings
scope_of_work: Installation of two (2) relocatable classroom buildings, associated ramps, utilities, and site improvements at Longley Way Elementary School.
general_contractor: Argee Construction Inc., dba Craftsman Construction
urgent_care_address: 101 Wheeler Ave, Unit B, Arcadia, CA 91006
fire_access_routes: Existing fire department vehicular access lane 20'-0" minimum unobstructed width. Fire apparatus access roads and water supply for fire protection shall be installed and made serviceable prior to and during construction (CFC §501.4).
fire_protection_equipment: Existing fire hydrants on site. Knox boxes at pedestrian and vehicle gates with keys for exterior doors, gates, and fire alarm panels per fire department notes.
smoking_cooking_policy: Smoking prohibited on site except in designated areas approved by the LFA. No open-flame cooking on site.
incident_reporting: Site safety director reports emergencies to 911 and notifies LFA. Serious accidents reported to Cal/OSHA per contractor IIPP.
lfa_site_specific: Coordinate fire watch during hot work. Maintain 20'-0" fire lane per site plan during construction of relocatable buildings.
